record.paper_title: Open Problems in Constructive Function Theory
record.original_question: Let ℓ(z)=z-a be linear and let m_1(ℓ,r) denote the minimum, over all linear multipliers q, of the maximum of |ℓ(z)q(z)| on the circle |z|=r. Compute m_1(ℓ,r). More generally, estimate the planar Lebesgue measure of the set of points a for which |a|>1 and m_n(p,r) exceeds a given threshold for polynomials p of degree n.

evidence.quote: QUESTION 6.1. (I) Compute m_1(ℓ,r), where ℓ(z)=z-a is a linear function. (II) Ultimately, one would like to estimate quantities such as ... where area denotes planar Lebesgue measure.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a polynomial $p$ of degree $n$ and a real number $r>0$, define
$$m_n(p,r) \;=\; \inf_{q}\;\max_{|z|=r}\,|p(z)\,q(z)|,$$
where the infimum is taken over all monic polynomials $q$ of degree $n$ (equivalently, the natural minimization over multipliers of matching degree, normalized so the trivial choice is excluded).

(I) Let $\ell(z)=z-a$ be a linear polynomial with $a\in\mathbb{C}$. Compute $m_1(\ell,r)$ explicitly as a function of $a$ and $r$, i.e. determine
$$m_1(\ell,r) \;=\; \inf_{q(z)=z-b,\;b\in\mathbb{C}} \;\max_{|z|=r}\,|(z-a)(z-b)|.$$

(II) More generally, for a fixed degree $n\ge 1$, a fixed radius $r>0$, and a fixed threshold $T>0$, estimate the planar Lebesgue measure
$$\operatorname{area}\bigl\{\,a\in\mathbb{C}\;:\;|a|>1 \text{ and } m_n(p_a,r) > T\,\bigr\},$$
where $p_a$ ranges over a prescribed family of degree-$n$ polynomials parametrized by $a$ (for instance $p_a(z) = z^n - a$ or $p_a(z) = (z-a)^n$). Provide sharp bounds or asymptotics for this area as the relevant parameters vary.
artifact.category_tag: Polynomial multipliers and Chebyshev-type extremal problems
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search for the specific quantity $m_1(\ell,r)$ and the associated planar measure estimates did not return results addressing this multiplier-minimization problem. No paper resolving the explicit computation of $m_1(\ell,r)$ for linear $\ell$ or the area estimate for $m_n(p,r)$ exceeding a threshold could be located, so the current status is inconclusive.
